{{nihongo|'''Mamezuka Shrine'''|豆塚神社|Mamezuka Jinja}} is a [[Shinto]] shrine in {{ill|Izunokuni|ja|伊豆の国市|qid=Q863758}}, [[Shizuoka Prefecture]], Japan. It is listed in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]] as a {{ill|Shikinai Supershrine|qid=Q135419779}} and is classified as a {{ill|Shikinai Shōsha|ja|式内小社|qid=Q134917287}} (small-grade Engishiki shrine) and a {{ill|Kokuhei-sha|qid=Q135160342}}. The shrine is incorporated as a [[religious corporation]].

== Overview ==

Mamezuka Shrine stands along {{ill|Shizuoka Prefectural Route 134|ja|静岡県道134号静浦港韮山停車場線|qid=Q11663292}} (known locally as the "Strawberry Road"), at the boundary between the Kita-Ejima and Minami-Ejima districts of Izunokuni. The surrounding Ejima area has deep historical ties to {{ill|Hōjōji (Izunokuni)|ja|北條寺|qid=Q117794411}} and {{ill|Hōjō Yoshitoki|ja|北条義時|qid=Q1028811}}.

The shrine traces its origin to '''Ishitokutaka Shrine''' (石徳高神社), which was originally situated on the summit of Mount Otoko (大男山, also called Yūtokuzan / 雄徳山) to the south. When the course of the {{ill|Kano River|ja|狩野川|qid=Q6364188}} divided the region, the shrine was separately re-enshrined in two successor locations: Mamezuka Shrine in Ejima-go and {{ill|Moriyama Hachimangu (Izunokuni)|ja|守山八幡宮 (伊豆の国市)|qid=Q116968871}} in Hōjō-go.

In Ejima-go, the shrine was relocated in stages—passing through Maruyama (near the present-day {{ill|Ejima Tollgate|ja|江間料金所|qid=Q11551378}})—before being moved to its current site at Mamezuka by Hōjō Yoshitoki. After this final relocation the shrine came to be known as '''Mamezuka Daimyōjin''' (豆塚大明神).

In September 1873 (Meiji 6), the shrine was designated a {{ill|Gō-sha|ja|郷社|qid=Q134917316}} (village-group shrine) under the modern shrine ranking system.

== Deities ==

* '''Ishitokutaka-no-Mikoto''' (石徳高命)

== Subsidiary shrine ==

Within the shrine grounds stands {{ill|Ishitokutaka Shrine (Mamezuka Shrine)|lt=Ishitokutaka Shrine|qid=Q135192938}}, itself regarded as one of the successor shrines to the original Ishitokutaka Shrine.<ref>Kokugakuin University Shrine database (Q135159299) https://jmapps.ne.jp/kokugakuin/det.html?data_id=181619</ref>
